name: Emission Warning
Emission Warnings
desc: You feel an ominous pressure building in the atmosphere. An emission is coming - find shelter immediately!
apply_message: The air feels heavy and wrong. Something terrible is about to happen.

name: Emission Exposure
Emission Exposures
desc: You were caught in an emission! Your body and mind are severely damaged by the Zone's fury.
The emission has left you broken and changed.
You barely survived the Zone's wrath - you may never fully recover.
apply_message: Reality tears around you as the emission strikes!
remove_message: The worst of the emission damage begins to heal.
hurt_msg: The emission energy courses through your body, destroying cells and corrupting DNA.

name: Zone Radiation Sickness
Zone Radiation Sicknesses
desc: Prolonged exposure to Zone radiation is making you sick.
Advanced radiation poisoning from Zone exposure.
You're dying from massive radiation exposure.
apply_message: You feel violently ill from radiation exposure.

name: Background Radiation
Background Radiations
desc: You're being exposed to elevated radiation levels from the Zone environment.
Moderate radiation exposure from your surroundings.
High radiation levels are slowly cooking you from the inside.
apply_message: You enter an area with elevated radiation.

name: Psychic Storm Exposure
Psychic Storm Exposures
desc: A psychic storm is assaulting your mind with alien thoughts and visions.
The psi-storm is tearing at your sanity.
Your mind is being shredded by overwhelming psychic forces.
apply_message: Alien thoughts invade your mind as the psi-storm hits!
